title: workspace-runtime generates a claude agent file for each authored `@agent-profile`
summary: @inventarch/workspace-runtime adds the ./internal/generate subpath, which exports generateAgentProfiles(reader, within, host) with the GeneratedFile and GeneratedWord types. For the claude host it returns, by identity, one frozen {path, text, identity, word: 'agent-profile'} per `@agent-profile` at band 100 (authored by the workspace) that the scope token admits, path being .claude/agents/<profile name>.md. The text is YAML frontmatter (the JSON-quoted name, and a description taken from the meaning.says of the profile's composition.agent), then the marker `<!-- Generated by ia project; edit the cited native records. -->` on its own line, then a body naming the profile and its agent, with a Mandate section holding the authority fields (participant, moves, scope, excluded words, covers) and execution.limit-* fields the profile's own composition.mandate states, or the one line 'This profile names no mandate.'; a Voice section with the voice's communication fields when composition.voice is set; a Tools section with one line per capability naming its operations, its effects and the host tools those effects cover through the prose profiles' effect table (read covers Read, Glob and Grep; no other effect maps a tool); and a Delegates section with one line per composition.delegates reference, which are not refused. A reference that no admitted record in the scope answers is printed as authored, and the agent, mandate, voice and capability lines then say it is not admitted in this scope. The bytes depend only on the records: no absolute path, time, scope token or revision. A profile below band 100, where an installed or adopted base places the public vocabulary, renders nothing; a workspace that authors public systems itself renders their profiles. Codex returns no file, an unknown host is refused with IA-PROJECTION-INPUT-INVALID, and for either host an unknown or stale scope token keeps its database code. Limits: nothing writes these files yet, so ia host, ia project, the distribution planner and the steward hook are unchanged; a profile that names no mandate does not fall back to the participant's mandate; the frontmatter names no tools or model, so the listed host tools restrict nothing; and conditional field values are not rendered.
